title: POST /api/decks/areas/batches/:uid/retry-failed (D1600, #3879)
description: The reply the deck v2 adapter's `retryFailed` method passes through: the new run of only the failed areas, the areas it retries and its quote, drawn from what is left of the first run's hold (`routes/deck_batches.ts`). The same Idempotency-Key again answers the same reply.
